en.quote: These were local self-defense forces [in Crimea].
en.head: “Our servicemen stepped in.”
en.body: On April 17, 2014, during the Direct Line, Putin said: “Behind the Crimea self-defense forces, of course, stood our servicemen.” On March 4, he had said that the question of Crimea’s accession was “not being considered.” On March 18, Putin signed a treaty on Crimea and Sevastopol joining Russia.

notes: The bracketed “[in Crimea]” is an editorial clarification in the Russian quote; retain as an insertion. The wording “local self-defense forces” follows the Russian phrasing; review against the original recording if exact terminology matters.
